`_from_xarray` now unconditionally calls `_unflatten_snapshots` for snapshot-dimensional arrays attached to a network, without checking semantics or the option. For an array with a flat object index of `(period, timestep)` tuples and matching auxiliary coordinates, this converts the snapshot index to a MultiIndex before pandas conversion, whereas the base code leaves it flat. Thus the returned pandas index can differ even under legacy semantics with the default or `"multiindex"` setting.
